title: Days Open shows whole days since creation and reads "0 days" / "1 days" (not pluralized) — expected, do not file
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows a work order created today, one created exactly one day ago, and one created several days ago.
custom_steps:
1. Read the Days Open cell of the work order created today.
2. Read the Days Open cell of the one-day-old work order.
3. Read the Days Open cell of the older work order and compare against its creation date.
custom_expected:
1. Days Open is the whole number of days since the work order was created — elapsed time divided by 24 hours, floored, never negative — rendered as "X days".
2. A same-day work order shows "0 days" and a one-day-old work order shows "1 days".
3. The value is NOT grammatically pluralized: "1 days" (not "1 day") is the correct, expected rendering.
